title: Reading Bible Stories — God's Word for Us
memory_verse: "Everything that was written in the past was written to teach us." — Romans 15:4 (NIV)
objective: Students will practice reading simple sentences from Bible stories.
content: You have learned so much about reading! Now let's use what we know to read simple Bible stories!
Let's read about Noah: 'God told Noah to build a big ark. Noah said yes to God. The rain came down. God kept Noah safe.' You can read all of those words!
Let's read about David: 'David was a boy. He loved God. God made David brave. David trusted God.' What a wonderful story!
The Bible is full of amazing stories about God and His people. The more you practice reading, the more of God's Word you can read all by yourself!
activity: Read these simple Bible sentences out loud with help: 'God is good. God loves me. I love God. God made the sun. God made me.' Draw a picture of your favorite Bible story.
discussion: What is your favorite Bible story?
